root_idea.summary: The root centers on presence, nearness, and being at hand.
root_idea.development: From this orientation, the lexicon develops the meanings of readiness and preparation, including things set aside for future use, as well as specialized terms for prepared equipment, a fit horse, a mature goat, and a prepared container.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form IV perfect citation form.
Displayed as the Quranic adjective and substantivized nominal عَتِيد.

senses.definition: To prepare, make ready, or set aside for a future need, occasion, or event.
senses.usage_conditions: Transitive Form IV usage; the prepared object may be something appointed or reserved in advance, including a consequence or punishment.

senses.definition: Ready, present, at hand, or near in the sense of being immediately available.
senses.usage_conditions: Used attributively or predicatively for something prepared or present. In the expression رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌ, it describes a watcher ready or at hand in relation to people's deeds.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become ready, at hand, or prepared.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form I use, said of something that is ready or has become ready.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become great, large, or bulky.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct Form I usage describing size or substantial bulk.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be exacting, careful, or fastidious in one's work, craft, or performance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form V usage concerning precision or scrupulous quality in an activity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A horse made ready or fit for running or riding, strong and sound in build and capable of repeated runs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized equine designation applied to either a male or female horse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Apparatus, implements, instruments, or equipment; especially weapons, animals, and military gear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A collective noun for the equipment assembled or taken for an undertaking, particularly warfare.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A large drinking cup or bowl.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal usage, including a large wooden bowl or cup.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A young goat, especially one that has begun grazing, grown strong, or reached an age suitable for breeding.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The precise age specification varies in the cited lexical accounts; the term may be applied to either sex.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A receptacle or small case for perfume, unguent, fumigation materials, grooming articles, or valued personal items.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A prepared tray, box, casket, or similar container, including one used for a bride's personal and cosmetic articles.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Form I meaning of being large or bulky.
Form IV preparation meaning, explicitly Quran-attested.
Form V usage describing exacting work.
Quran-attested ready, present, or near meaning.

cautions: The derivation of Form IV أَعْتَدَ is disputed in the cited lexical discussion: one account relates it to أَعَدَّ through consonant substitution, while another rejects that explanation.
Lane's printed Quran citations use historical notation; the modern verse locations presented here are taken from the supplied QAC occurrences rather than reconstructed from Lane's notation.
